description: openai-java-core provides the HTTP-client-agnostic core of the official OpenAI Java SDK, including the request/response models, the OpenAIClient and OpenAIClientAsync interfaces and implementations, JSON serialization, and error handling for the OpenAI REST API. It is combined with an HTTP transport, such as openai-java-client-okhttp, to form a complete client, as bundled by the openai-java umbrella artifact.
